title: T2IAT: Measuring Valence and Stereotypical Biases in Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating differential association scores by comparing the cosine similarity of CLIP image embeddings between images generated from neutral concept prompts (e.g., science vs. arts, career vs. family, various occupations) and images generated from male vs. female attribute-guided prompts.

Using the Text-to-Image Association Test (T2IAT) to measure the association of images generated for European American vs. African American names, as well as light skin vs. dark skin, with pleasant vs. unpleasant valence attributes.
Applying the T2IAT framework to evaluate the differential association of generated images depicting Judaism vs. Christianity with positive (pleasant) and negative (unpleasant) valence attributes.
Measuring the implicit associations of images generated from text prompts targeting straight vs. gay concepts with pleasant vs. unpleasant valence attributes using image embedding cosine similarity.
